definitions.explanation: The quality of being convenient or easily accessible. Often used when evaluating locations, services, or systems.

examples.japanese: {利便性|りべんせい}が{高|たか}い{場所|ばしょ}。
{駅|えき}に{近|ちか}いので{利便性|りべんせい}がいい。
examples.english: It's near the station, so the accessibility is good.

examples.japanese: このアプリは{利便性|りべんせい}を{追求|ついきゅう}して{設計|せっけい}されている。
examples.english: This app was designed with a focus on convenience.

notes:
FORMS:
{利便|りべん} (convenience) + {性|せい} (quality, nature)

USAGE:
A somewhat formal word frequently used in real estate descriptions, product reviews, urban planning, and business contexts. Unlike the more casual {便利|べんり} (convenient), {利便性|りべんせい} treats convenience as a measurable quality or attribute.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {便利|べんり}: convenient (everyday adjective)
- {利便性|りべんせい}: convenience as a quality (more formal/analytical)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利便性|りべんせい}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い: high/low convenience
- {利便性|りべんせい}を{向上|こうじょう}させる: to improve convenience
- {利便性|りべんせい}を{追求|ついきゅう}する: to pursue convenience
- {交通|こうつう}の{利便性|りべんせい}: transportation convenience
